subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require live or sanctioned Feishu CardKit proof after repair, or apply a proof override for this external PR once the helper and rebase blockers are fixed?
rationale: The contributor says they cannot access a live Feishu tenant plus DeepSeek setup, while ClawSweeper cannot treat helper console output and mocked tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a visible channel-delivery change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Maintainer Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accept the risk for this channel fix.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and have recent history in the affected Feishu streaming-card final delivery path.
